meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 CDP 协议控制你电脑上的 Chrome 浏览器，复用已登录的账号状态。它能打开网址、等待页面加载、执行 JavaScript、截取页面快照，还能从浏览器里提取登录令牌。启动前会先检查状态，需要重启 Chrome 时会先征求你的同意。
howto.when: 当你说要操作浏览器、复用登录态，或提到“CDP”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 https://example.com 并读取页面文字
say.note: Claude 会用调试 Chrome 打开并抓取页面文字

say.text: 提取当前页面里的登录 token
say.note: 从 localStorage 或 cookie 中读取

say.text: 用 CDP 截取当前页面的快照
say.note: 生成交互元素快照，便于后续操作

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will control your local Chrome browser via CDP to reuse existing login sessions. It can open URLs, wait for page load, evaluate JavaScript, take snapshots, and extract auth tokens. Before starting, it checks status and asks your consent if Chrome needs to be restarted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to operate the browser, reuse login sessions, or mention keywords like CDP.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and read the page text
say_en.note: Claude opens it in debug Chrome and extracts text

say_en.text: Extract the login token from the current page
Take a snapshot of the current page via CDP
say_en.note: Produces interactive element snapshot for later use
